mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.title, c.model, c.del_flag AS delFlag, c.create_by AS createBy, c.update_by AS updateBy, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_agent_conversation (id, user_id, title, model, del_flag, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{model}, '0', #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_agent_conversation SET model = #{model}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_agent_conversation c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.del_flag = '0'
SELECT FROM t_agent_conversation c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_agent_conversation SET del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.sql: m.id, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.role, m.content, m.attachments, m.reasoning, m.model, m.prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, m.completion_tokens AS completionTokens, m.cost_ms AS costMs, m.create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_agent_message (id, conversation_id, role, content, attachments, reasoning, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_ms, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{attachments}, #{reasoning}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{costMs}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_agent_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.id ASC
